column1: # Each release and launch-fleet unit's time in seconds, for ci/shard/lanes.py (#743, #854).
# From the members' shard records (the shard-ran-1-* artifacts) of green run
# One run, so each row is that run's time. `site` (the combined site work, which
# runs in release only on a selected site-and-release PR) was not in that run;
# its row is kept from #743's: the site job's build-and-test step.
# Refresh it the same way, from newer members' records.
# A unit with no row counts as the longest; a test.sh group past the last row
# goes to shard ((GROUP - 1) mod N) + 1. Stale rows only cost balance: every
# unit still runs exactly once, and the ci job checks it.
# #1132: four-CPU fixture workload plus all existing suite checks; historical evidence in #1132.
